node_context: CA1 radiatum giant cell (ca1_radiatum_giant_cell): a rare, specialised glutamatergic projection neuron located in CA1 stratum radiatum (UBERON:0005372). Distinct from CA1 pyramidal cells. First described by Kirson & Yaari 2000 (PMID:10864941). Unique electrophysiology: NMDA receptor-dependent burst firing in response to synaptic activation even after blocking non-NMDA receptors — a property not shared with pyramidal cells. Minimal characterisation: no defining markers known, morphology notes limited to soma location in stratum radiatum.
